bio.text: Julie VanOrden is a Republican who represents District 30 in the Idaho Senate and is listed in a third term; the directory lists VanOrden as an agribusiness co-owner and homemaker.
According to the legislature's biography, VanOrden is a lifelong resident of Idaho and Bingham County and graduated from Blackfoot High School and ISU Vocational Technical Education.

It says VanOrden is a former member of the Idaho House of Representatives and former chair of its Education Committee, and a former commissioner on the Idaho Public Charter School Commission and the Idaho Potato Commission.
